verses.text: LORD, I take refuge in you. Never let me be put to shame.
In your righteousness, come to my rescue. Bend down to hear me and save me.
Be my rock of refuge, somewhere I can always go. Give the order to save me, because you’re my rock and my fortress.
Rescue me, my God, from the grip of the wicked, from people who do wrong and act cruelly.
You are my hope, Lord GOD. I’ve trusted you since I was young.
I’ve depended on you since before I was born. You brought me out of my mother’s womb. I’ll always praise you.
Many people look at me in wonder, but you are my strong refuge.
My mouth is full of your praise and speaks of your honor all day long.
Don’t cast me aside in my old age. Don’t leave me when my strength gives out.
My enemies talk about me. The ones waiting to take my life make plans together,
saying, “God has left him. Chase him and catch him, because no one will rescue him.”
God, stay close to me. My God, hurry to help me.
Let my accusers be put to shame and brought to an end. Cover those who want to hurt me with disgrace and scorn.
I’ll keep hoping in you and give you more and more praise.
I’ll speak of your righteousness and your salvation all day long, even though I can’t take in how great they are.
I’ll come telling the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I’ll speak of your righteousness, yours alone.
God, you’ve taught me since I was young. To this day I’ve told people what wonders you’ve done.
Even when I’m old and gray, God, stay with me until I’ve told the next generation about your strength and everyone yet to come about your power.
Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, God. You’ve done great things. Who is like you?
You’ve made us see many bitter troubles, but you’ll give me life again. You’ll bring us up from the depths of the earth.
Restore my honor and comfort me again.
I’ll praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I’ll sing to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
My lips will shout for joy! My soul, which you’ve redeemed, will sing your praise.
I’ll tell of your righteousness all day long, because those who wanted to harm me have been put to shame and confusion.
